disposition_reason: The source defines ordered behavioral R2 and neural-state endpoints, but the complete published MINT score vector, exact original memberships, and full author baseline route are not recovered. The bundled full-paper interface contains 17 distinct analysis obligations; neither its earlier Area2-only example nor the four-dataset behavioral panel establishes full-paper improvement.

source_paper.title: An emerging view of neural geometry in motor cortex supports high-performance decoding

evidence.locator: Results: Behavioral decoding across multiple datasets; Comparison to other decoders; Figures 4–5; Methods Datasets and Tables 2–4
evidence.supports: Four-dataset primary behavioral panel uses 15 behavioral groups and causal neural history. The paper also analyzes nine empirical datasets, simulations, a multitask network, limited data, neuron loss, and NLB neural-state estimation.

evidence.locator: Methods: Decoding R2; Hyperparameter optimization; Neural Latents Benchmark; Table 5
evidence.supports: Defines 5-ms behavioral coefficient of determination, circular treatment of phase, averaging within groups, ten network initializations, training-only model selection, and separate NLB endpoints.

evidence.locator: Getting Started; Running MINT; Repository Structure
evidence.supports: Author release is explicitly a basic implementation; some paper variants and search automation are omitted. Provides Area2_Bump, MC_Maze, and MC_RTT examples and a separate comparator repository.
Bins reference/prediction traces to 5 ms, concatenates trial samples, removes insufficient-history NaN predictions, and computes 1−SSE/SST for each behavior dimension.

evidence.locator: trial_alignment; test_alignment; trajectory settings; causal/history configuration
evidence.supports: Area2 example uses movement-aligned evaluation −100 to +500 ms, 25-ms smoothing, 20-ms spike bins, and a 240-ms causal history. This verifies one example, not all paper variants.

target.description: Estimate behavior from simultaneous neural spikes, preserving the source behavioral variables and the distinct neural-state estimation, generalization, neuron-loss and simulation analyses. Figure 5 assesses 15 groups over four datasets; Figure 8 adds limited-data sessions. These cannot be collapsed with NLB bits/spike or timing into one invented scalar.

dataset.description: The original nine empirical datasets are Area2_Bump, DMFC_RSG, MC_Cycle, MC_Maze, MC_Maze-L/M/S, MC_RTT and MC_PacMan, plus maze simulations and the multitask network. Source data routes are documented, but exact immutable payload equivalence, generated realizations, and historical NLB submission assets remain unbound.

cohort.description: Table 2 identifies neural populations and trial counts: for the primary panel, Area2_Bump 65 neurons/364 trials, MC_Cycle112/273, MC_Maze182/2295 and MC_RTT130/1080. Full paper populations and source inclusion masks must be frozen; these counts alone do not authenticate unit or trial identities.

split.description: Table 4 specifies primary training/test counts272/92,174/99,1721/574 and810/268 respectively; MC_RTT excludes its first two candidate test segments for shared history support. Original membership/order, validation folds and seeds are unbound. NLB Table5 has distinct hidden trials and held-in/held-out neurons; a fresh split is an extension.

inputs.description: Original behavioral decoders receive matched trailing spike observations with20-ms bins, equal original training data and causal information boundaries; source factorial acausal cells remain separately named. NLB permits its own within-epoch neural-state inputs, never hidden evaluation labels.

preprocessing.description: Tables3–4 specify dataset-dependent alignment, Gaussian smoothing, trajectory averaging/dimensionality and evaluation epochs. Source Area2 config confirms its conventions, but authentic implementation of all datasets, MC_RTT AutoLFADS libraries, phase treatment and full variants is not established.

metric.description: Behavioral R2 is1−sum(y−prediction)^2/sum(y−mean(y))^2 over the original evaluation samples at5-ms resolution; phase uses circular distances and means. Source NLB bits/spike, PSTH R2 and velocity R2, as well as timing, remain separate estimands. Pearson correlation and MAE reported in the text are not interchangeable with Figure5 R2.

aggregation.description: Average per-dimension R2 within each source behavioral group; average groups for each dataset. Neural network results average ten seed runs. Preserve per-group/per-dataset outputs and all source analysis families; the paper does not define a global accuracy scalar over its17 registered modules.

comparison.primary_metric: Original behavioral-group R2 vector (Figures5 and8); separate original neural-state and robustness endpoints

published_baseline.description: Exact MINT R2 values for the full original vector were not recovered from reviewed text/code. The paper reports11/15 best behavioral groups and37/42 expressive-method comparisons, but these counts are not an R2 baseline. Reported velocity correlations and MAEs are distinct endpoints and are not substituted.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No authenticated author-baseline rerun on the exact original assessment has been established; source instructions are not an executed score.

minimum_effect.rationale: Justify an R2 gain relative to trial-level reference variability and the original behavior-specific scales across the complete original panel; the text’s negligible ΔR2<0.004 observation is descriptive, not an authorized universal margin. Source-score recovery and a full-family decision rule are still required.

uncertainty.method: Recover the source trial-bootstrap conventions and predeclare paired trial/contiguous-block resampling appropriate to each source analysis; aggregate seeds separately from biological units and account for multiple endpoint claims. Exact interval coverage and decision rule remain unapproved.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Held-out trials within original recordings; contiguous blocks for temporally adjacent MC_RTT segments; animal/session scope for any population generalization. Seeds and behavior dimensions are not independent biological replicates.
uncertainty.rationale: The source bootstraps trials and averages network seeds, but full-module dependencies and original trial identities are not established; no universal significance threshold is assigned.

paper_win_requires: Recover source numerical performance for every original retained endpoint and authenticate the corresponding data, memberships, preprocessing and author implementation.
Candidate improvement must be paired with MINT on the identical original task; freeze any primary comparison and non-degradation rule across the original metric family before final scoring.
Retain the full nine-empirical-dataset and original simulation/network scope of this registration; no Area2-only or four-dataset result may count as full-paper superiority.
Keep causal and acausal access, limited-data sessions, neural-loss masks and historical NLB evaluation distinct; a new split or newly generated simulation is a separately labeled extension.
Establish a justified effect margin and dependence-aware uncertainty; beating reconstruction tolerance or a local authored surrogate is not success.

current_sota.description: The source-paper comparator and a rerun of that method are distinct from current SOTA. No current-SOTA claim or verified contemporary comparison is made.

episode.improvement_loop: After baseline and original membership recovery, iterate only on original training data and training-derived validation feedback; retain all evaluated attempts and original component-specific access boundaries.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze executable method, preprocessing, hyperparameters, seed policy, all endpoint choices and access/resource ledgers before original final assessment.
episode.final_evaluation: Replay the frozen method and authenticated MINT baseline across the original complete scope with paired output-level comparisons; final outputs do not become subsequent tuning feedback.
episode.baseline_policy: The pinned basic MATLAB release is a baseline route for its supported examples only. Missing variants must be recovered faithfully; locally authored replacements, reconstruction success and new-split baselines cannot stand in for source MINT.

blocking_issues: Complete exact published MINT score vector is unavailable in the reviewed paper text and code; no invented aggregate score.
Original data identities, train/test membership, search folds, neural-loss masks and simulation/network realizations need authentication.
Pinned author code omits paper variants and hyperparameter-search implementation; native equivalence for the complete17-module interface is not established.
Historical NLB evaluator/submission/version and hidden-label access authority are not bound; no hidden labels were inspected.
Meaningful-effect and dependence-aware decision rules and concrete candidate access/compute budgets are not fixed.

legacy.notes: Preserve the original task, full-motormint-v1 interface, original graders and evidence. Its selected four-dataset predecessor and broader17-module construction are calibration/design artifacts; neither engineering controls nor historical R2 reconstruction is active improvement success.
